chunks: Originator of the heavens and the earth, He has made your consorts from among you, and made pairs of cattle. He multiplies you in this way. There is no other like Him. He is all-hearing and all-seeing.

key_terms.فَاطِرُ: Originator or Creator who brings forth from nothing

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Fatar as-samawat wa al-ard' in Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Ayat al-Fitr) is often cited to affirm Allah's absolute transcendence (Tanzih) while acknowledging His creative agency in establishing marital and biological order. The phrase 'He created for you from yourselves spouses' is interpreted not as physical reproduction of the Divine, but as a functional analogy for companionship and propagation, distinguishing human experience from the unique, incomparable nature of the Creator.
